Evidence.Measurement: Fixed full FM branch with +1.7 dB manual boost, aligned dry path, no loudness matcher. Two quartic halves fitted to RMS and K-weighted moments.
Evidence.Selection: The rational trial and the refitted polynomial have practically equal worst reversals; the PCM RMS difference is below 0.001 dB. Retain the simpler polynomial.
Evidence.FrozenEndpointMeasurement: Frozen endpoint PCM checkpoints were recorded at zero manual output boost and are scaled independently by the regression tests.

KnownLimits: The fixed boost does not equalize different voices or texts.
The quoted energy reversal is RMS/K-weighted energy, not a guarantee for gated integrated LUFS.
Short clips can change loudness-gate membership; the worst gated-LUFS reversal in the stress audit is reported separately.
At unity master the established pipeline bypasses its output limiter; sufficiently hot input can be clipped by PCM16 conversion.
The 305 moment cases and 37 PCM cases overlap; these are not independent voices or a blind holdout.

Evidence.LinearEndpointVerification: 2026-10-22: endpoint checkpoints use the independently rendered former FM path with only its instantaneous limiter bypassed. Mixer coefficients and the 305 historical calibration moments are retained; new final peak protection is checked separately.
